```artifact
Feature: Prescription Management

  Scenario: Generate a prescription for a patient consultation request
    Given a patient consultation request
    When the request is processed
    Then a prescription is generated
    And the prescription is mapped to the patient consultation request

  Scenario: Ensure each prescription is mapped to one and only one patient consultation request
    Given multiple patient consultation requests
    When each request is processed
    Then each prescription is mapped to a unique patient consultation request

  Scenario: Chemist receives one or more prescriptions
    Given a chemist
    When prescriptions are generated
    Then the chemist receives one or more prescriptions

  Scenario: Ensure each prescription is mapped to one and only one chemist
    Given multiple prescriptions
    When each prescription is processed
    Then each prescription is mapped to a unique chemist

  Scenario: Lab receives one or more prescriptions
    Given a lab
    When prescriptions are generated
    Then the lab receives one or more prescriptions

  Scenario: Ensure each prescription is mapped to one and only one lab
    Given multiple prescriptions
    When each prescription is processed
    Then each prescription is mapped to a unique lab

  Scenario Outline: Handle edge cases for prescription generation
    Given a patient consultation request with <edge_case>
    When the request is processed
    Then a prescription is generated
    And the prescription is mapped to the patient consultation request

    Examples:
      | edge_case |
      | no medication |
      | multiple medications |
      | urgent request |
      | delayed request |

  Scenario Outline: Handle invalid inputs for prescription generation
    Given a patient consultation request with <invalid_input>
    When the request is processed
    Then an error is returned
    And no prescription is generated

    Examples:
      | invalid_input |
      | missing patient information |
      | invalid medication details |
      | negative dosage |
      | expired medication |
```
